review_rationale: SEB skills versus personality traits are a substantive focus of the study.

review_evidence.evidence: [pp. 2-3] The study directly compares change goals and feasibility beliefs for SEB skills and corresponding Big Five traits.

meta_rationale: The quantitative constructs are change goals and feasibility beliefs rather than SEB skill level/capacity.

meta_evidence.evidence: [p. 5] The BESSI-45 was systematically modified for skill/trait change goals and feasibility beliefs.

quantitative_scope_rationale: BESSI-derived items are repurposed to measure beliefs/goals about changing SEB skills, not participants' SEB skill levels/capacities.

human_review_summary: Do BESSI-derived items repurposed to assess change goals/feasibility beliefs count as eligible SEB quantitative measurement?
ai_recommendation: Ineligible for meta-analysis because the measured construct is beliefs/goals about SEB skills rather than SEB skill level/capacity.
decision_options: ineligible because target construct is not SEB skill level/capacity
